# BugTrap

**BugTrap** is a tool to catch unhandled exceptions in unmanaged and managed .NET code. BugTrap also supports sending crash reports to a remote server for analysis.

## Download Sources & Binaries

- **GitHub**: https://github.com/bchavez/BugTrap

## Update Rules

1. Update sources (`src/`).
2. Update all binaries (`bin/` and `lib/`).
3. Update all header files (`include/`).
4. Verify compatibility with the project.
5. Update the README (version, download links, etc).
